mentions.name: AdMake AI
mentions.description: AI ads generator for Facebook ads that gives an easy way to prompt for ad creatives and keep track of good AI ad prompts. Used to produce static image ads for BestPhoto, achieving over 40 conversions at roughly $45 per conversion.
mentions.problem: The author's previous handmade ads made in Canva cost $80-100 per conversion, and Facebook often would not spend any of the ad budget at all.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://admakeai.com - AI ads generator for facebook ads. Made mostly so I have a easy way to prompt for stuff and keep track of good AI ad prompts.
